metadata.name: Clinic Ops Summary
metadata.description: Scheduled clinic operations digest: pull yesterday's appointment and service metrics, transform, summarize, and post to an internal channel.
metadata.rationale: Shadow TCM operations archetype. Preserves the scheduled ETL / HTTP / code / LLM / HTTP notification skeleton while moving the business text to clinic operations.

nodes.rationale: Run every morning so clinic operators start with a current operations digest.
Fetch the prior day's clinic operations data from the locked internal source.
Normalize appointment, no-show, service, and inventory signals into a compact summary table.
nodes.source:
records = [{'id': r['id'], 'visits': r['visits'], 'service': r['service']} for r in pull['body']]
return { 'records': records, 'count': len(records) }

nodes.rationale: Convert normalized metrics into a concise manager-facing clinic operations summary.
nodes.system_prompt: You write concise clinic operations digests for managers. Do not include patient-identifying details.

nodes.rationale: Post the approved operations digest into the configured internal clinic channel.
Expose delivery status and summary text for audit and downstream reporting.
